title: A unified view of nonlinear, nonlocal operators and qualitative properties of associated elliptic and parabolic problems
summary: We put together a general framework to deal with elliptic and parabolic equations associated with (nonlinear) nonlocal (fractional order) operators. Many well-known nonlocal operators enter into our framework, and in addition one may introduce many other, new nonlocal operators that have not yet been considered in the literature.
